purpose: Declares every formal/lean file that carries BOTH theorems and a trailing IO section, with the sanction each rests on. formal/mojo/proof_plane_guard_oracle.mojo fails closed on any trailing-IO file absent from this list, so the set cannot grow quietly, and on any file whose io_budget is exceeded, so a declared renderer cannot become a prober.

boundary.hard_rule: No IO declaration and no `def main` may appear BEFORE the last theorem in a theorem-bearing file. Lean requires declaration before use, so a trailing IO section cannot be an input to any proof above it. This arm has no exemptions and currently reads 0 across all 126 files.
boundary.why_not_a_name_allowlist: A name allowlist is an exemption wearing a sanction's clothes: it says a file is trusted, not why, and nothing re-checks the why. The entries below are checked mechanically against the scanner's output every run.
boundary.measured_by: tools/lean_proof_plane_scan.ml (strips nested /- -/ comments, -- lines, /-! docstrings and string literals before matching, because prose describing removed IO tripped the previous grep-based guard twice)

renderers.sanction: SC-MIRROR-PROJ-001. This file GENERATES CLAUDE.md and the four vendor rules/ surfaces; CLAUDE.md names it as its own generator, so the write is mandated, not tolerated. Verified with `tools/uos-surface-gen --check`.
renderers.why_this_is_not_an_observation_plane: It writes a file deterministically from the model and reads files back only to report drift against that model. No reading of the live system becomes an input to a theorem. Its `IO.FS.realPath` calls implement a write fence (resolveFence, :428) that keeps writes inside the repository root -- a safety control on its own effect, not a measurement of the world.

renderers.sanction: CLAUDE.md language roles: Lean 4 covers 'pure IO base scripting / SOP / SDLC / SRE orchestration in place of ad-hoc Python, Bash and sed'. emitBudgetCases/emitReplayCases enumerate the gate's own decision function to stdout.
renderers.why_this_is_not_an_observation_plane: Output is a total function of the model. An external checker can replay it; nothing is read from the world. This is the SAME shape as a differential oracle's algebra arm, run from the Lean side.

renderers.sanction: Same clause. The main enumerates 3x2x3x3x4x3x3x2x2x2x2 = 93,312 receipt configurations and prints `valid` for each, which is the admission predicate's full truth table over its finite domain.
renderers.why_this_is_not_an_observation_plane: Pure enumeration of a decidable predicate. It is the most useful kind of Lean `main` in this tree: it exports what the kernel decided so another language can be held to it.

renderers.sanction: Same clause, narrowly. Prints one `=MODEL_CONSISTENT` line naming what typechecked.
renderers.why_this_is_not_an_observation_plane: Changed from `=PASS` to `=MODEL_CONSISTENT` on 20261106-0108 for exactly this reason: a typecheck is not a system verdict (THM_VAC_01_typechecking_is_not_observation). G5 holds the whole tree to that.

renderers.sanction: Same clause. Two `def main` because the namespaced one is re-exported at top level for `lean --run`.
renderers.why_this_is_not_an_observation_plane: Banner changed to `=MODEL_CONSISTENT` 20261106-0108. The 12 C-ABI exports it names are declarations, not probes.

Every interpolated value is a projection of a model record. OPEN NONCONFORMANCE, recorded rather than silently fixed: three of its 15 lines read as live claims -- 'Zenoh Mesh Active', 'Live Digital Twin Bound', 'GPU Graph verified' -- which the file cannot establish by typechecking. They are model fields whose names assert runtime state. Renaming those FIELDS is the follow-up; the banner is honest about being MODEL_CONSISTENT, so this is a wording defect, not a boundary breach.
